canonical_title: Groq shuts down Llama 3.1 8B Instant and Llama 3.3 70B Versatile for free and developer tiers
treatment: Recovered from the prior night search-failure window. Repeat only for rollback, enterprise-tier impact, migration changes, or a materially different Groq production replacement.
known_facts: Groq set August 16, 2026 as the shutdown date for llama-3.1-8b-instant and llama-3.3-70b-versatile on free and developer tiers.
Enterprise customers with committed-spend contracts are not affected by this deprecation.
Groq recommends openai/gpt-oss-20b for Llama 3.1 8B Instant and openai/gpt-oss-120b or qwen/qwen3.6-27b for Llama 3.3 70B Versatile.
reinclude_only_if: Groq restores either model ID for affected tiers.
Groq changes the enterprise exemption or recommended replacements.
A material compatibility or outage issue emerges from the migration.
